title: Seminar in Mediated Communication; Media, Misinformation, and Public Opinion
description: This course will examine misinformation in our evolving media environment across a range of science, health, and political contexts. We will draw on interdisciplinary research and theory to explore topics such as the factors that drive misinformation beliefs, the impacts and effects of misinformation on individuals and society, and current research-based and practical approaches for correcting misinformation.
